policy.anchor_value_rule: Values are transcribed, never recalled. Every field carries a locator + verbatim quote + file sha256 inside this environment. Fields with no available source are recorded as MISSING with status WITHHELD; they are NOT filled from memory.

provenance_grades.A: digit-exact value quoted from the primary document (resolution / workshop proceedings) present in the environment
provenance_grades.B: secondary transcription: an in-ecosystem file that states the primary document as its source; primary document NOT accessible offline
provenance_grades.C: order-of-magnitude / bracket statement only, explicitly flagged by its own source as non-digit-exact
provenance_grades.MISSING: no transcription available in this environment

policy.scale_basis_rule: Each field states its scale caliber (full scale / model scale / dimensionless-by-L). Mixing calibers without conversion is forbidden; comparisons must be same-caliber.

conflicts.detail: ship-performance-platform charger lists "zigzag_10_second_overshoot_deg": 25.0 while TensorLBM's transcription puts 25 deg as the 20/20 FIRST-overshoot limit and 40 deg as the 20/20 SECOND. The two are incompatible as labels.
conflicts.resolution_for_w22: Use the TensorLBM set (10/10 first: 10 deg for L/V<10 s, 20 deg for L/V>=10 s; 20/20 first 25, second 40) because it is the only transcription that states the L/V branch required by the mission brief ('Z 形首向超调判据按 L/V 条件另列'). The ship-performance-platform value is recorded, not used.
conflicts.status: UNRESOLVED at source level (primary resolution PDF not offline) -> flagged, both kept in provenance

completeness.honest_statement: The MSC.137(76) side of the anchor set is complete (direction + unit + scale caliber + L/V condition recorded, grade B). The SIMMAN 2008 KVLCC2 numerical baseline side is missing 3 of 3 required numeric fields; therefore anchor completeness is 75%, not 100%, and criterion 1 of the mission is honestly FAIL.

blocked.what_is_missing: Digit-exact SIMMAN 2008 KVLCC2 advance / tactical-diameter / 10-10 overshoot (and PMM derivative) table values, i.e. the 'SIMMAN 2008 proceedings' numeric pages, model scale or full scale.
blocked.why_blocked: Offline environment: no network egress (external HTTPS is blocked by policy) and no in-repo/on-disk transcription of those tables exists.
blocked.unblocks_next: Any of: (i) SIMMAN 2008 proceedings PDF/table scan ingested as a source transcription (benchmarks/anchors/sources/*.transcription.json style); (ii) an authoritative digitised KVLCC2 PMM/zigzag dataset (e.g. ITTC 7.5-02-06-03 sample or Yasukawa & Yoshimura 2015 table) supplied as an anchor document; (iii) a KVLCC2 EFD-to-full-scale zigzag table from the towing tank report.
blocked.consequence: Criterion 3 (<15% same-caliber comparison against SIMMAN KVLCC2 single-screw baseline) is WITHHELD, not PASS; only the same-model podded-vs-single-screw delta is reported.
